rationale: The final 1-minute candle printed a large bearish body from 85.15 to 84.69 on 11k shares, more than double any of the preceding four candles. Price sits 0.80% off the session high exactly at the 0.8% trailing take-profit threshold, with the bid-ask spread widening to 85 bps and the last print tagging the low of that candle. Although still above the 5-minute 9-EMA and at 92.3% of the daily range, the sudden volume spike and loss of the higher-low pattern since entry supply sufficient mechanical evidence to exit.
